008package paint.fiji.trackmate;
009
010import paint.shared.utils.TextFiles;
011import org.apache.commons.io.FileUtils;
012import paint.shared.config.paintconfig.PaintConfig;
013import paint.shared.config.SweepConfig;
014import paint.shared.utils.PaintLogger;
015import paint.shared.validate.JsonValidator;
016
017import java.io.IOException;
018import java.nio.file.*;
019import java.util.ArrayList;
020import java.util.Arrays;
021import java.util.List;
022import java.util.Map;
023
024import static paint.fiji.utils.SweepFlattener.flattenSweep;
025import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.THRESHOLD;
026import static paint.shared.constants.PaintFileNames.PAINT_CONFIGURATION_JSON;
027import static paint.shared.constants.PaintFileNames.PAINT_SWEEP_CONFIGURATION_JSON;
028import static paint.shared.constants.PaintFileNames.EXPERIMENT_INFO_CSV;
029
030/**
031 * Coordinates a "parameter sweep" execution for TrackMate across multiple
032 * experiments. For each active sweep parameter, the Paint configuration
033 * is duplicated and modified, and the entire project is reprocessed.
034 * <p>
035 * This class enables systematic parameter-space exploration for TrackMate
036 * within Paint’s experiment framework.
037 * </p>
038 */
039public class RunTrackMateOnProjectSweep {
040
041    /**
042     * Executes the TrackMate analysis workflow across multiple parameter
043     * configurations defined in the sweep configuration file.
044     * <p>
045     * For each parameter–value combination, this method:
046     * <ul>
047     *   <li>Creates a clean subdirectory under the project’s "Sweep" folder.</li>
048     *   <li>Copies and modifies the Paint configuration file.</li>
049     *   <li>Runs all selected experiments under that parameter setting.</li>
050     *   <li>Logs results and restores the original configuration afterward.</li>
051     * </ul>
052     *
053     * @param projectPath     the root directory of the Paint project
054     * @param imagesPath      the directory containing experiment image data
055     * @param experimentNames list of experiments to include in the sweep
056     * @return {@code true} if all sweep combinations complete successfully;
057     *         {@code false} otherwise
058     * @throws IOException if any file or directory operation fails
059     */
060    public static boolean runWithSweep(Path projectPath,
061                                       Path imagesPath,
062                                       List<String> experimentNames) throws IOException {
063
064        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
065        // Phase 1 – Load sweep configuration
066        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
067        Path sweepFile = projectPath.resolve(PAINT_SWEEP_CONFIGURATION_JSON);
068        if (!Files.exists(sweepFile)) {
069            PaintLogger.infof("No sweep configuration found at %s", sweepFile);
070            return false;
071        }
072
073        JsonValidator.Result validation = JsonValidator.validate(sweepFile);
074        if (!validation.valid) {
075            PaintLogger.errorf("Invalid JSON: " + validation.error);
076            return false;
077        }
078
079        SweepConfig sweepConfig = new SweepConfig(sweepFile.toString());
080        Map<String, List<Number>> sweeps = sweepConfig.getActiveSweepValues("TrackMate Sweep");
081
082        if (sweeps.isEmpty()) {
083            PaintLogger.infof("Sweep enabled, but no active sweep parameters defined.");
084            return false;
085        }
086
087        boolean overallStatus = true;
088
089        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
090        // Phase 2 – Generate sweep summary for logging
091        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
092        List<String> sweepSummary = new ArrayList<>();
093        sweepSummary.add("");
094        try {
095            for (Map.Entry<String, List<Number>> entry : sweeps.entrySet()) {
096                String       parameter = entry.getKey();       // parameter name
097                List<Number> values    = entry.getValue();  // list of values
098
099                // Convert values to comma-separated string
100                String valueList = values.stream()
101                        .map(Object::toString)
102                        .reduce((a, b) -> a + ", " + b)
103                        .orElse("(none)");
104
105                // Add a header line for the parameter
106                sweepSummary.add(String.format("Parameter: %s", parameter));
107                sweepSummary.add(String.format("Values:    %s", valueList));
108                sweepSummary.add("");
109            }
110
111            // Add the experiments section at the end
112            if (experimentNames != null && !experimentNames.isEmpty()) {
113                String exps = String.join(", ", experimentNames);
114                sweepSummary.add(String.format("Experiments: %s", exps));
115            }
116        } catch (Exception e) {
117            PaintLogger.errorf("Error building sweep summary: %s", e.getMessage());
118        }
119        PaintLogger.doc("Sweep analysis to be performed", sweepSummary);
120
121        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
122        // Phase 3 – Perform parameter sweep
123        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
124        try {
125            for (Map.Entry<String, List<Number>> entry : sweeps.entrySet()) {
126                // Cycle through the parameters
127                String parameter    = entry.getKey();       // Holds a parameter that we sweep
128                List<Number> values = entry.getValue();     // Values holds the values
129
130                // NOTE: nothing is captured for "restoration" here, deliberately.
131                //
132                // A sweep never modifies the project's configuration: each value copies the
133                // pristine project config into its own sweep directory and PaintConfig is
134                // repointed at that copy (below), so every write lands on the copy.
135                //
136                // There used to be a "restore the original value" step at the end of this loop.
137                // It was wrong twice over: by then PaintConfig pointed at the *last sweep
138                // directory*, so it wrote the original value into that sweep's config — destroying
139                // the record of which value actually produced those results — and on the second
140                // and later parameters it had *read* the "original" from a sweep copy rather than
141                // from the project. Restoring the config context (not the value) is handled once,
142                // in the finally block.
143
144                for (Number val : values) {
145                    PaintLogger.blankline();
146                    PaintLogger.blankline();
147                    PaintLogger.infof("Running sweep for %s = %s", parameter, val);
148
149                    // Create clean sweep directory
150                    Path sweepPath = projectPath.resolve("Sweep").resolve("[" + parameter + "]-[" + val + "]");
151                    FileUtils.deleteDirectory(sweepPath.toFile());
152                    Files.createDirectories(sweepPath);
153
154                    // Copy baseline PaintConfig.json
155                    Path baselineConfig = projectPath.resolve(PAINT_CONFIGURATION_JSON);
156                    Path configCopy     = sweepPath.resolve(PAINT_CONFIGURATION_JSON);
157                    try {
158                        Files.copy(baselineConfig, configCopy, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
159                        PaintLogger.infof("Copied baseline PaintConfig.json to %s", configCopy);
160                    } catch (IOException e) {
161                        PaintLogger.errorf("Failed to copy PaintConfig.json to %s: %s", configCopy, e.getMessage());
162                    }
163
164                    // Reinitialize PaintConfig for this sweep
165                    PaintConfig.reinitialise(sweepPath);
166
167                    // Apply updated parameter value if it is value that need to be changed in the configuration
168                    if (!THRESHOLD.equals(parameter)) {
169                        if (val.doubleValue() == val.intValue()) {
170                            PaintConfig.setInt("TrackMate", parameter, val.intValue());
171                        } else {
172                            PaintConfig.setDouble("TrackMate", parameter, val.doubleValue());
173                        }
174                    }
175
176                    // Persist modified configuration
177                    PaintConfig.instance().save();
178
179                    // Copy Experiment Info.csv files into sweep directory
180                    for (String expName : experimentNames) {
181                        Path expSrc    = projectPath.resolve(expName).resolve(EXPERIMENT_INFO_CSV);
182                        Path expDstDir = sweepPath.resolve(expName);
183                        Path expDst    = expDstDir.resolve(EXPERIMENT_INFO_CSV);
184                        try {
185                            if (Files.exists(expSrc)) {
186                                Files.createDirectories(expDstDir);
187                                Files.copy(expSrc, expDst, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
188
189                                if (THRESHOLD.equals(parameter)) {
190                                    PaintLogger.infof("Updating threshold %f for %s", val.doubleValue(), expDst);
191                                    updateThreshold(expDst, val.doubleValue());
192                                }
193                            } else {
194                                PaintLogger.warnf("Experiment Info.csv not found for %s at %s", expName, expSrc);
195                            }
196                        } catch (IOException e) {
197                            PaintLogger.errorf("Failed to copy Experiment Info.csv for %s: %s", expName, e.getMessage());
198                        }
199                    }
200
201                    // Run TrackMate workflow for all experiments under current sweep
202                    boolean status = RunTrackMateOnProject.runProject(projectPath, imagesPath, experimentNames, null, sweepPath);
203
204                    // (A "summaryRows" list used to be built here and then never read. Each run
205                    // already logs its own outcome, and overallStatus carries the verdict.)
206                    if (!status) {
207                        overallStatus = false;
208                    }
209                }
210
211            }
212
213        } finally {
214            // Always restore PaintConfig context to the project root
215            PaintConfig.reinitialise(projectPath);
216            PaintLogger.infof("Restored PaintConfig to project root: %s", projectPath);
217        }
218
219        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
220        // Phase 4 – Flatten results (optional)
221        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
222        if (overallStatus) {
223            flattenSweep(projectPath.resolve("Sweep"), experimentNames, true);
224        }
225
226        return overallStatus;
227    }
228
229    public static void updateThreshold(Path csvPath, double newValue) throws IOException {
230
231        List<String> lines = TextFiles.readAllLines(csvPath);
232        if (lines.isEmpty()) {
233            return;
234        }
235
236        String   header         = lines.get(0);
237        String[] cols           = header.split(",");
238        int      thresholdIndex = -1;
239
240        for (int i = 0; i < cols.length; i++) {
241            if (THRESHOLD.equalsIgnoreCase(cols[i].trim())) {
242                thresholdIndex = i;
243                break;
244            }
245        }
246
247        if (thresholdIndex < 0) {
248            throw new IOException("CSV does not contain a 'Threshold' column: " + csvPath);
249        }
250
251        List<String> output = new ArrayList<>();
252        output.add(header); // keep header unchanged
253
254        for (int row = 1; row < lines.size(); row++) {
255            String[] parts = lines.get(row).split(",");
256            if (parts.length > thresholdIndex) {
257                parts[thresholdIndex] = String.valueOf(newValue);
258            }
259            output.add(String.join(",", parts));
260        }
261
262        Files.write(csvPath, output, StandardOpenOption.TRUNCATE_EXISTING);
263    }
264}
